C2: QUALIFIED: bounded dependencies and NAV changes are supported; each forward introductory-core disposition below is resolved, without ordinary/fallback negative-answer approval.
C3: PASS within the assigned Russian teaching bodies; explanations and translations are natural and preserve the relevant distinctions without a consequential mistranslation.

Findings: no significant source/content or Russian-language defect requiring correction was found in the assigned new kanji lessons or NAV changes. Genuine lexical overlap remains a limitation, not evidence erased by a qualified contrast. No source metadata correction is warranted: corrections=[]. Frozen community N3 labels are not historical KANJIDIC JLPT labels; original structure-unclassified tags remain unchanged. Modern-shape mnemonics are explicitly not etymology. Exact JMdict form misses establish neither invalidity nor absence/frequency.

Directional dispositions
Q means ONLY a qualified forward introductory-core teaching contrast. It is not unrestricted wrong-answer approval, all-sense disjointness, reading-mode safety, global uniqueness or ordinary/fallback suitability. No reverse, transitive or clique inference follows.
089-N001 余→会 Q: surplus/remainder differs from meeting; an extra meeting is a shared situation, not the same introductory meaning.
089-N002 余→金 Q: surplus differs from gold/money; surplus money combines the concepts without equating their cores.
089-N003 余→茶 Q: remainder differs from tea; leftover tea does not make tea the introductory meaning of 余.
089-N004 便→体 Q: convenience differs from body/form; stool and bodily functions explicitly prevent universal separation.
089-N005 便→借 Q: convenience differs from borrowing/renting; a convenient loan is contextual association, not core equivalence.
089-N006 便→住 Q: convenience differs from residing; convenient accommodation does not identify their introductory meanings.
089-N007 係→休 Q: connection/person-in-charge differs from rest; responsibility for breaks is contextual, not core synonymy.
089-N008 係→体 Q: connection/duty differs from body/form; bodily duties do not equate the offered introductory meanings.
089-N009 係→作 Q: responsibility/connection differs from making/creating at introduction; 係る being someone's work/result creates real wider overlap, so unrestricted separation is unwarranted.
089-N010 信→借 Q: trust/belief differs from borrowing/renting; 信用 financial credit overlaps the borrowing domain and forbids a blanket financial separation.
089-N011 信→何 Q: trust/belief differs from interrogative what; asking what one believes does not equate those introductory meanings.
089-N012 信→休 Q: trust/belief differs from rest; shared situations do not supply core synonymy.
089-N013 備→借 Q: preparing/equipping differs from borrowing/renting; borrowed equipment can serve preparation without making the verbs equivalent.
089-N014 備→側 Q: preparing/equipping differs from side; equipment positioned beside something is contextual combination.
089-N015 備→働 Q: preparing/equipping differs from working/functioning as an introductory focus; preparation can itself be work, so no universal exclusion follows.
089-N016 働→動 Q: human labor versus physical movement is a warranted introductory contrast only. Whole 1451150 and 1451210 share operation/work; 1451040 includes movement; 1590520 has 稼働/稼動. Both Russian bodies disclose breadth. This is expressly not an all-sense or fallback-safe foil ruling.
089-N017 働→重 Q: working/functioning differs from heavy/layered; heavy work or important functions do not equate the introductory cores.
089-N018 働→側 Q: working/functioning differs from side; working at someone's side is association, not introductory synonymy.
089-N019 優→夏 Q: gentleness/excellence differs from summer; Buddhist and seasonal associations do not equate their introductory meanings.
089-N020 優→借 Q: gentleness/excellence differs from borrowing/renting; kindness through lending is a situation, not the same lexical core.
089-N021 優→側 Q: gentleness/excellence differs from side; a superior side or kind party does not make those introductory meanings interchangeable.

Source rulings and clarifications
ACCEPT here accepts only the stated bounded source ruling/clarification, not batch acceptance.
089-L001 ACCEPT; 089-A001 ACCEPT: kanji/余.md retains ヨ/all four kun, distinguishes intransitive 余る/transitive 余す, あまり-only noun/suffix restrictions and sense-specific usually-kana uses; literary よ pronoun is not ordinary surplus.
089-L002 ACCEPT; 089-A002 ACCEPT: kanji/便.md retains ベン/ビン/たより and convenience, service/mail, news and stool families; 便り versus 頼り is correctly distinguished. 更 is a modern mnemonic, not etymology.
089-L003 ACCEPT; 089-A003 ACCEPT: kanji/係.md retains all four kun, independent かかり versus suffix -がかり, and 係るかかる versus 係わるかかわる, including work/result breadth; homophones do not license arbitrary spelling replacement.
089-L004 ACCEPT; 089-A004 ACCEPT: kanji/信.md preserves frozen kun=[] without claiming universal absence of kun; 信じる is on-based ichidan. Trust, financial credit and communication breadth are preserved, not treated as proof or universal disjointness.
089-L005 ACCEPT; 089-A005 ACCEPT: kanji/備.md distinguishes transitive ichidan 備える from intransitive godan 備わる; possession is not birth-only. Usually-kana つぶさに and rare spelling 悉に do not justify calling the reading archaic.
089-L006 ACCEPT; 089-A006 ACCEPT: kanji/働.md has official 国字 attestation while retaining ドウ/はたらく; function/operation/movement and 稼働/稼動 overlap is real. The independently resolved N016 qualification above does not erase it.
089-L007 ACCEPT; 089-A007 ACCEPT: kanji/優.md retains all three kun and ユウ/ウ; Buddhist ウ examples support attestation, not frequency/necessity. 優しい versus 易しい, 優れる versus 優る, and grade/excellence senses are correctly distinguished.

Dependencies, NAV and excluded conclusions
Frozen EN kanji/系.md and kanji/憂.md do not exist; they remain metadata/visible-shape comparison components, not invented source lessons/providers. The new 備→働 dependency is closed by the reviewed candidate lesson; omitted untranslated optional links do not create invented Russian content.
NAV: ACCEPT 9/9 exact patches, nine wrappers, in words/不便.md, words/便利.md, words/信号.md, words/働く.md, words/優しい.md, words/優秀.md, words/準備.md, words/郵便局.md and words/関係.md. Only existing explanatory glyphs gain correctly targeted kanji links. Existing semantics, metadata, readings, examples and Markdown spans are preserved; no baseline word semantic amendment is approved or implied. All nine whole current word bodies were actually read among the context pairs.
The seven outside-edge observations are bounded risk prompts, not seven fresh global pair rulings, new guards or an exhaustive pool matrix. Existing word guards carry original scope/identity only. Protected033 WORD空 remains excluded/UNVERIFIED; accepted077 KANJI空 does not resolve it. Prior082-N007 姉→妹 remains its original unrestricted U.
Broader ordinary quiz suitability, modern necessity/frequency, and global current/future uniqueness remain UNVERIFIED. sourceAccepted=false. This report alone is NOT acceptance. No delegation, writes, tests/builds, Git mutations, network/auth, activation, device or media actions were performed; no native/device/media/package/default/IME/release approval or proof is supplied.
